Title: Bearly Escaping
Description: Breaking out of captivity, Bearitrice is trying to escape. Hunters surround, traps a plenty. It's time for her survival instincts to kick in.
Game Concept: Survival high score game - the longer you survive the more points you get

Bearitrice.Description: Bearitrice is the bear the player controls, should be a big cute bear

Map.Description: The general play area - should be randomly generated and everything needs to be randomly adjusted inside the bounds

Hunters.Description: Enemy units who shoot, or throw nets, or set up traps

Still Need: run into them -> lower speed for 0.2 seconds by 50 (balance?)
Moving - Keeps a certain distance away from Player - so when too far moves towards slowly, when too close, moves away quickly
Scripts.Completed: Killable, removed from scene when killed

Tranquilizer.Description: A projectile that will not kill the bear but it will slow down for a set time

Net.Description: Projectile object that will catch you. Arrow Key Code for release.

Pit Trap.Description: Stationary object that will catch you. Arrow Key Code for relase. Look just like bushes
Pit Trap.Sprite: bush sprite created, but need trap frame, also variety

Bushes.Description: An object that can be walked through, when inside you are hidden from Hunters but lose points
Bushes.Sprite: Bush sprite created, hidden bear sprite created, need additional variety

Arrow Key Code.Description: Code gets longer each time you get caught. Incorrect Input or when hit it 'resets' the code. (Random Sequence UP,DOWN,LEFT,RIGHT)

Objects.Description: Stationary Objects you can't move or destroy (eg. trees/houses)

Score.Description: Multipliers as you kill hunters or break traps - highest multiplier when in enrage mode but it drops down to 1x after

Food.Description: 0.3 second sit down to eat and reset speed to default, and add points

Enrage.Description: Obtain the enrage through either killing hunters/traps or alternatively getting hit or trapped by bullets/traps, each time you use it, it gets harder to get
Enrage.Sprite: Enrage Progress Bar, Also need to implement 'ENRAGE' filter/camera zoomed in

Still Need: Disable button when enrage is not available

Lofty Goal: Set up a High Score Leaderboard
Achievements - eg. get to score 100000 without getting caught
